future_check: If any authority file changes, rerun selected exact sync and cross-source execution parity atomically before intake.
rationale: Rewriting the archival raw source would be unrelated churn. The selected authority is exact at byte, whitespace-normalized, and comment-stripped levels; both distinct executable source groups solve all four canonical pairs.
summary: No Racket patch is proposed: canonical program_solution and selected target_code are exact, while raw_code remains a distinct archival executable source with full execution parity.

future_check: Require every named semantic witness to fire in every band and preserve at least one blocked and one odd-distance distractor in identifiable lessons.
rationale: A curriculum containing only clean even pairs teaches the shortcut “fill every matching pair.” The branch-complete template makes negative conditions visible and keeps every lesson non-identity and answerable.
summary: Generalized lessons deliberately combine blocked, odd-distance, horizontal, vertical, and long clear segments.

future_check: After any schedule edit, rerun both disjoint 200-per-band censuses and require at least 5% strict support in every band.
rationale: The original generator could pass coarse diversity checks without a pinned, count-backed canonical anchor. A 25% linked prior keeps all four canonical endpoint topologies visible while leaving 75% of draws for generalized anti-shortcut scenes.
summary: Ordinary draws reserve exactly two of eight schedule residues for strict canonical topology profiles in every difficulty band.

future_check: Treat a band-zero witness warning as a release blocker even when pooled support is healthy.
rationale: An intermediate implementation correlated profile choice with schedule residue and made the long-segment witness disappear from the easy pinned census. Independent keyed selection restored all canonical subprofiles in all bands without global RNG use.
summary: Canonical topology selection uses a keyed RNG independent of the eight-residue schedule.

future_check: Any new AXES entry must be observed exactly at both boundaries in all three bands and included in the checker-generated matrix.
rationale: Baseline evidence showed four texture aliases were byte-identical, several exact axes lacked provenance, and unknown keys were swallowed. Keeping those declarations would make the public contract unfalsifiable.
summary: The repair removes dead palette, density, texture, and position aliases instead of pretending they are exact public overrides.

future_check: Apply the generator patch and optionally copy the check-side regression test into tests/ before replay.
rationale: The intake contract rejects generator__TASK patches containing more than one diff; the regression test is preserved verbatim under checks/.
summary: The slim return patch contains only the assigned production generator.

future_check: Monitor task-family balance at pool assembly rather than inflating this generator beyond its canonical geometry.
rationale: The downstream quality report flags median input area 66 and density 0.14 versus global reference values, but this is intrinsic to the canonical point-pair task; malformed, no-op, constant, and collapse counts are all zero.
summary: The task remains intentionally sparse and smaller than the repository-wide ARC evaluation median.
